headline: Iraqi Crude Moves Beyond Hormuz on a VLCC
deck: Iraq's Oil Tankers Company says a VLCC took two million barrels beyond the Strait of Hormuz, the company's first such operation in decades.
body: Iraq's Oil Tankers Company said Saturday it had carried two million barrels of Iraqi crude on a very large crude carrier to a location beyond the Strait of Hormuz. [E1]
The company said the voyage was its first such operation in decades. [E2]
